items.title: TensorFold update keeps a large model's weights wired in memory while idle on macOS, cutting a cached follow-up's first token from about 1 to 2.5 s to 0.016 s
items.summary: A TensorFold update keeps roughly 300GB of DeepSeek V4.1 wired instead of letting macOS release it after each request. On an M5 Ultra a cached follow-up reportedly dropped from about 1 to 2.5 s to 0.016 s time to first token. Numbers are from the posters and no benchmark recipe is linked.

items.title: MiniCPM-OCR gets native vLLM and SGLang support
items.summary: OpenBMB says its MiniCPM-OCR model now runs natively in vLLM and SGLang, so developers can serve it with either framework without custom integration. No benchmark or repo link in the post.
